narrative_purpose: Makes the diagnostic features of a secondary marine return visible: internal air channels and true anchoring roots on a fully submerged plant, which is what a land lineage that went back to the water looks like.
subject: A fully submerged underwater scene. In the foreground, two broad ribbon-like fronds rise from the seabed, each cut open lengthwise so the interior shows long pale hollow channels running the length of the tissue like parallel tubes, a few of them holding visible trapped bubbles. Beneath them, fine branching roots grip into pale sediment rather than merely resting on rock. Behind and to one side stands a submerged trunk with slender glowing tendrils drifting upward from its crown into the water column. In the far background, low mounded reef structures fade into the blue-dark distance.
scene: A calm shallow reef floor in deep blue-green water, faint shafts of surface light filtering down, suspended particles drifting.
camera: A low underwater view close to the seabed, looking slightly upward past the fronds so their cut interiors face the viewer.
light: Cool filtered light from far above, plus bioluminescent self-glow in the drifting tendrils and a faint pale luminosity inside the air channels so the cavities read clearly against the tissue; deep indigo shadow in the water beyond.
palette: Void-indigo and ocean-teal water, living-teal in the frond tissue, pale mist highlights inside the hollow channels, scarce magenta on the drifting tendrils.
style: Painterly naturalist cutaway plate, hand-painted texture, underwater atmospheric depth.
detail_level: Crisp on the cut frond interiors, the hollow channels and the root grip in sediment; the submerged trunk softer; the far reef dissolving into haze.
composition: Two cut fronds occupying the left and centre foreground, the tendrilled trunk offset to the right, open dark water across the upper frame for later callouts.
consistency_notes: Cool Pandora palette in an underwater key. The hollow internal channels are the entire point of the figure and must be unmistakable; the roots must clearly penetrate sediment rather than clinging to rock like an alga's holdfast.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no diagram labels, no arrows, no leader lines, no fish, no divers, no photographic or 3D-render look, no lens flares, no cartoon or anime style
